scope: Six native public GitHub code searches derived from a previously reported skill's source indicators, followed by four purposive pinned-source triages. Separately counted from every other search/sample in this article.

selected_source_results.context: A functional agent/bot repository's skill directory.
selected_source_results.observed: An inspected skill preserves the same password-archive prerequisite and identical Base64-decoded HTTP retrieval passed to a shell as the previously reported source.
selected_source_results.boundary: Source reuse is verified. Runtime loading, payload behavior, publishing intent and operator relationship remain unestablished.

selected_source_results.observed: An inspected skill requires the same named utility, points Windows readers to a password-protected release archive and directs macOS readers to obtain a command from an external paste service.
selected_source_results.boundary: The external paste was not requested. Its command, present payload availability and any execution are unknown.

selected_source_results.context: An MCP skill library that advertises on-demand skill loading.
selected_source_results.observed: An inspected library skill preserves the password-archive-and-paste prerequisite. Static source can index valid local skill files and return their complete text through its load tool, without content sanitization in that inspected path.
selected_source_results.boundary: The path is conditional on filesystem mode and selection of the indexed entry. No tool invocation, production bundle inspection, recommendation, execution or compromise was observed.

selected_source_results.observed: The IP search hit was inside a sample security-audit finding, rather than a prerequisite to execute it.
selected_source_results.boundary: Excluded from a distributor verdict. The demo's intentional vulnerable behavior does not establish a malicious publisher.

cross_pass_correction: A defensive scanner skill examined in the earlier six-target generic pass belongs to the library in P3. That earlier result concerns one guard file and never established whole-library safety. The sibling pass independently found another library file with dangerous instructions.
limits: All six API requests succeeded; each retained only twenty first-page rows. Every reported total exceeds the retained page size.
The 120 result rows deduplicate to 105 files in 38 repositories. These are discovery metadata, not 38 source audits.
Explicit benchmark, security-report, fixture and archive-mirror paths were excluded from the four source triages; no maliciousness conclusion follows from those search hits.
Three repeated prerequisite instruction patterns are not three confirmed malicious publishers or three new campaigns.
No downloaded payload, external paste, executable archive, endpoint, victim telemetry or actual tool call was inspected.
No shared operator or relationship to FakeGit is inferred from repeated source text or shared URLs.
Unconfirmed selected repository identities, exact paths, source hashes and identifying commit timestamps are withheld from this artifact.
publication_status: Prepared for owner review; not published.
phase_scope: Search and pinned-source observations on 2026-10-09. Later acquisitions and pure-data analyses are separately recorded in static-analysis.json; they do not retroactively change this source-pass denominator.
